Missions

Serving Our Missions-Minded God

We are actively involved in missions around the world. We seek to involve our members in international and domestic trips. We also financially support Southern Baptist missions through gifts to the Lottie Moon Christmas Offering, Annie Armstrong Easter Offering and Cooperative Program.

We have partnerships & missionaries in the following places worldwide:

Japan
Central Asia
Thailand
Puerto Rico
